description: MarginCue for Claude Code: see how the agent will read your prompt before you send it, and steer its choices while it works.

plugins.name: margincue
plugins.description: Shows how Claude Code will read your prompt before you send it, checks the names you use against your code, gives each open choice a control, sketches the result, and lets you switch the agent's own choices while it works.
